articles.title: She Earns $170K At 27, He's A Teacher With A Trust — His 'Old Money' Millionaire Parents Say It's 'Emasculating' And Expect Her To Stay Home
articles.mainIdea: She Earns $170K At 27, He's A Teacher With A Trust — His 'Old Money' Millionaire Parents Say It's 'Emasculating' And Expect Her To Stay Home
articles.summary: Benzinga: She Earns $170K At 27, He's A Teacher With A Trust — His 'Old Money' Millionaire Parents Say It's 'Emasculating' And Expect Her To Stay Home. A 27-year-old woman said her fiancé's parents called her career "emasculating" and expected her to quit working after marriage. In a post shared on the r/AITAH subreddit, the original poster wrote that she earns more than $170,000 a year, while her fiancé works as a teacher and earns significantly less. She added that he comes from an "old money" family and has a trust fund. As the wedding approached, she wrote, his parents became increasingly uncomfortable with the income imbalance. Don't Miss:
